explanations: BatchLoader only batches the load() calls made in the same tick. teamDirectory awaits inside a for loop, so each employee's loads are dispatched, and their queries finish, before the next employee's loads even start. The inner Promise.all makes the three lookups for one person run in parallel, but every employee still costs its own round of queries, which is N+1 with extra steps. The latest-review lookup is different for each person, so the cache can't save it. The fix maps all employees to promises at once and awaits them together with Promise.all. Then every load lands in the same tick and each loader sends one query for the whole team, which also keeps the rows in the original order.
